personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with structural clarity for business ERP
personality_one_liner: A premium, highly disciplined executive cockpit that uses extreme structural clarity, deep sophisticated neutrals, and generous spacing to make complex retail data feel effortless and calm.

spacing.rule: Use 8pt grid system. Maintain generous horizontal margins (lg/xl) for safe areas, and tighter vertical spacing (sm/md) within data rows to ensure information density without clutter.

navigation: bottom_tabs with side drawer/hamburger for secondary deep links

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary for elevated elements.
Use subtle gradient scrims only over hero background images to ensure text readability.
dont's: Do not use full glassmorphism, blur, or heavy transparency on UI cards.
Do not use frosted glass on the tab bar or headers; keep it matte and solid to maintain the serious ERP look.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Executive business cockpit providing a high-level summary of daily performance, pending actions, and recent activity.

states.loading: Skeleton loader for KPI cards and charts.
states.empty: No data yet. Illustration + 'Log your first sale to see insights'.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard data. 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Hero header with 'Good morning' personalization over a subtle premium abstract background. Horizontal swipe row for 'Needs Your Attention' (amber/red alerts). 2-column grid for key KPIs formatted in Indian currency (₹ L/Cr). Interactive Line Chart card (7D/30D toggle). Recent Activity timeline block at the bottom.

screens.name: POS / Checkout
screens.purpose: Fast, high-density terminal for creating invoices and managing the cart.

states.loading: Spinner centered in the product grid.
states.empty: Empty cart state with an illustration and 'Scan a barcode or add products' CTA.

screens.layout: Top sticky search bar and barcode scan button. Grid/List toggle in the subheader. Main area is an image-driven product picker. Bottom sheet (or right drawer on tablet) handles the active Cart, Customer details, and pinned 'Charge ₹X' primary CTA at the bottom over the safe area.

screens.name: Inventory
screens.purpose: Overview of products, accessories, stock levels, and quick stock transfer actions.
screens.layout: Sticky filter chips (All, Low Stock, Phones, Accessories). Data list with thumbnails, product names, SKU, and right-aligned stock status badges (Green/Amber/Red). Tapping a row opens a bottom sheet with detailed product specs, stock across shops, and edit/transfer actions.

dashboard_hero_bg.alt: Subtle premium gradient background for the executive header.

empty_state_illustration.alt: 3D hand holding a smartphone representing empty data or action required.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. In Light mode, do NOT use pure white for the main background; use #F9FAFB. In Dark mode, use #111827, not pure black.
Implement Indian currency formatting strictly: e.g., ₹42,850, ₹8.42L, ₹1.24Cr. Ensure numbers in the Executive Dashboard are appropriately sized (large hierarchy for values, smaller for labels).
Do NOT use glassmorphism. The user explicitly requested 'NOT full glassmorphism', favoring subtle depth, soft neutral backgrounds, and controlled shadows (tier 1).
For the POS screen, ensure the cart summary and the 'Charge / Pay' primary CTA is always pinned above the home indicator, regardless of scrolling through the product catalog.

Data components (KPI cards, Table rows, Inventory items) should utilize the structural clarity of Brutalist layouts (clear alignment, obvious hierarchy) but softened with 'iOS-Native Clean' radii (md: 10px, lg: 16px) to maintain a premium feel without looking cluttered.
Include a 'Needs Your Attention' section in the Dashboard with actionable cards using semantic colors (warning/error).
Always use the 'Inter' font (weights 400/500 only, size creates hierarchy). Do NOT use bold cuts like 700 or 800.
When displaying products/brands, utilize the real fetched logos (e.g., Apple, Samsung) from the images list instead of generic vector icons or initials where applicable.
Ensure the success state after an invoice is created is a premium, full-screen takeover (or large modal) featuring a big checkmark, the Invoice number, and clear actions (Print/Share/Download).
